question: Which flying unit from 1 tier building in BAR can shoot and stun enemy targets?

The Hippogryph Aviary is a Tier-1 Night Elf production building. It trains the
Hippogryph Rider, upgraded to the Dragonhawk Rider, a true flying ranged unit.

The Dragonhawk Rider attacks from the air with Frost Arrows. The projectile is a ranged shoot attack and the Frost Arrows apply a hard slow/stun-type crowd control on hit, i.e. the classic “shoot-and-stun” air harassment unit you can get already in Tier 1 with the Aviary. In game parlance that is the Hippogryph/Dragonhawk line that is usually quoted for the Tier-1 Night Elf air option.
